recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-35996; any concern about R4B-era validation messages or Lantern checks belongs outside this current-build reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-35996 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and reported that CapabilityStatement invariant cpb-3's human text incorrectly said messaging endpoints were required when kind = instance, while the FHIRPath only disallows endpoints unless kind = instance. The accepted resolution was to leave the expression alone and change the human text to say messaging endpoints are only permitted when the capability statement is for an implementation.
initial_application: Git commit 5503d2443d90ecb82728a617a9d3477bee9d530d applied FHIR-35996 by changing source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-CapabilityStatement.xml from the old required-and-permitted wording to the approved only-permitted wording.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current StructureDefinition has cpb-3 human text matching the Jira resolution with expression messaging.endpoint.empty() or kind = 'instance'. FHIR-I WGM minutes confirm the 2022-05 Persuasive 22-0-0 vote. A 2025 Zulip implementer question referenced R4B/Lantern confusion and R5's corrected wording, but did not identify a current-source conflict.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The current active source already implements the approved correction and contains no stale copy of the old required-and-permitted wording.
